The exclusion default should honor the required environment variable so CI configuration takes effect.

## Changes
The pull request adds repeatable `--exclude GLOB` filtering, skip logging, documentation and tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, you still archive `.log` files because the default is `[]`. This violates “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (`.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5`). — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the required environment variable silently include files they intended to omit.
